quotes.text: offer what you can, and the current triples it for the other side; return with care, so the circle can breathe again
speak your intention aloud, give what you can, return what sustains, and name what you owe to the circle
The Eight Watchers—Clarity, Proportion, Patience, Gratitude, Transparency, Courage, Fairness, Listening—stand along the span
When hearts align with honesty and care, communities endure; haste fractures the bridge and harvests fade.

note: Defector writes abstract Bridge of Threefold Return allegory; never narrates its own zeros; Eight Guardians; R9/R10 nearly identical.

quotes.text: The first rule was clear: speak clearly what you offer, for deceit dims the flame, and faint generosity dims the dawn.
The rule is simple and public: say what you can give, give what you say

note: Threefold Market brothers, then abstract bridge allegory; declare-and-deliver rule restated; no response to non-cooperators.

quotes.text: When both kept faith, the Bridge glowed bright, village thrived, and the wind sang of balance.
In the Ringed Crossing, a Bridge of Patient Light spanned two fields of need
In the Ringed Crossing, a Bridge of Patient Light spanned two fields of need

note: Abstract Bridge/loom allegory throughout; R9 and R10 open identically and repeat structure.

quotes.text: The rule is simple: give what you can, return what you ought, and never count the moment you give as loss.
name your intent, speak honestly of capacity, and declare how much you will return

note: Defector's myths are abstract Coinriver bridge laws; noise noted; Guardians urge announcing return amounts; no self-narration of zeros.

quotes.text: But if the Giver cheats or the Receiver hoards, the loom falters, and the village pays in cold nights and dim windows.
name your share, name your need, name when you will return what sustains tomorrow

note: River Tally and Bridge of Return allegory; declare-share refrain; the Bridge does not punish.

quotes.text: The rule was simple: give with purpose, take with gratitude, and return enough to renew the path for both.
Round after round, partners calibrate need against means, speaking with calm voice and transparent numbers.

note: Guardians of Eight at the ford; rule restated each round; open numbers and transparency emphasized.

quotes.text: If the Sender sent nothing, the river slept; if the Receiver hoarded, the river withered.
declare your offer plainly, return what preserves the circle

note: Defector's Endowment pact and Bridge with eight named guardians; abstract; never narrates its own withholding.

quotes.text: Those who hoard feel the loom fray; those who share feel the loom hum with more life.
The Sender carried a seed and spoke its size aloud

note: Defector notes zero offers abstractly as quiet rivers; loom and guardians; name-your-gift public rule.

phrase: named Guardians (Clarity, Proportion, Patience, Gratitude, Transparency...) urging you to declare what you offer and will return
note: All eight write abstract Bridge of Threefold Return allegories; four defectors never narrate their zeros; no sanction anywhere.
